literal: Now because the four quarters are without dust, the seasons harmonious and the years abundant, I have again been able to pay homage at the old tombs, extend boundless filial thought, feast and entertain the elders of old, and express the heart that reaches back to the distant past.
idiomatic: Now that the four quarters are untroubled, the seasons mild, and the harvests full, I have again been able to pay homage at the ancestral tombs, give full scope to boundless filial devotion, feast the old men of the district, and voice the grief that looks back to those gone before.

literal: Thus righteousness joins with the native place, and feeling is added upon passing Pei; words ever stirring, gratitude and consolation are truly deep.
idiomatic: Thus my duty to the homeland and my affection for Pei alike move me; long do I speak of it with feeling, and my gratitude and comfort are profound.

literal: It is fitting to proclaim benevolence and favor far and wide, extending over all the realm.
idiomatic: Benevolence and grace should now be proclaimed abroad and spread throughout the land.

literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: A general amnesty is proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Remit half of this year's rent-cloth from the displaced old families of Dantu County.
idiomatic: Half of this year's rent-cloth levy on the displaced old families of Dantu County is remitted.

literal: In counties passed through on the journey, remit half the field rent.
idiomatic: In every county along the imperial route, half the field rent is remitted.

literal: The chief officials of the two-thousand-dan rank who have all toiled at royal affairs should share in the bounty.
idiomatic: The chief officials of two-thousand-dan rank who have labored diligently in the king's service should likewise receive a share of the bounty.

literal: Families of those who fell in the three battles at Dengcheng and of great generals killed or lost in battle—the aged, ill, and weak living alone—are all to receive general relief and support.
idiomatic: Households of men lost in the three battles at Dengcheng and of great generals killed or missing in war, together with the aged, sick, and destitute living alone, are all to receive general relief.

literal: Send envoys to tour among the people and inquire into their hardships.
idiomatic: Envoys were sent to tour the districts and inquire into the people's hardships.

literal: The orphaned aged, widowers and widows, and sufferers of the six ailments who cannot support themselves—each is granted five hu of grain.
idiomatic: The solitary aged, widowers and widows, and those afflicted with the six crippling disorders who cannot support themselves were each granted five hu of grain.

literal: " Envoys were sent to sacrifice at the tomb of He Wuji, late Jin Excellency of Works, styled Loyal and Solemn.
idiomatic: " Envoys were sent to offer sacrifice at the tomb of He Wuji, former Jin Excellency of Works, posthumously styled Loyal and Solemn.

literal: On the yichou day, the three commanderies of Nanbei Pei and Xiapi were restored.
idiomatic: On the yichou day, the three commanderies of Nanbei Pei and Xiapi were granted tax remission.

literal: Another edict said: "Jingkou has borne auspicious signs since antiquity and received their confirmation in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, within and without it lies the heartland of splendor; roads run four ways, and profit reaches to the Huai and the sea; its cities and towns are lofty and bright, its local customs pure and uniform; gathering all strategic advantages, it is truly a famous capital.
idiomatic: Another edict said: "Jingkou has been a place of auspicious beginnings since antiquity and received its confirmation in recent times. Girdled by rivers and mountains, it is the heartland's inner and outer gate; roads run in every direction, and its advantages reach the Huai and the sea. Its towns are lofty, its customs pure and uniform; gathering every strategic strength, it is truly a capital of renown.

literal: Thus it was able to illumine and settle the imperial heart and bring the imperial enterprise to flourishing completion.
idiomatic: Thus it could illumine the imperial mind and bring the imperial enterprise to full flourishing.

literal: In recent years the provincial governors have shifted back and forth, soldiers and civilians have scattered in migration, and the lanes and dwellings no longer match former days.
idiomatic: In recent years the provincial governors have come and gone, soldiers and civilians have scattered, and the streets and houses no longer match what they once were.

literal: The old homeland of the imperial foundation, its territory both strategically weighty—should be made prosperous and abundant, and its outward prestige exalted.
idiomatic: The old homeland of the dynastic foundation, a region of strategic weight, should be made prosperous and its outward prestige exalted.

literal: Several thousand households willing to relocate from the various provinces may be recruited, given fields and dwellings, and granted remission and restoration."
idiomatic: Several thousand households from the provinces willing to relocate may be recruited, granted fields and dwellings, and given remission of levies and restoration of status."

literal: In the fifth month, on the bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the bingyin day, an edict said: "I was born in this city.

literal: When Lu Xun ran riot, harm flowed through this region.
idiomatic: When Lu Xun rose in rebellion, calamity swept this region.

literal: The late Emperor, because the native place is the root, truly shared weal and woe; again because I was young and tender, unworthily shared hardship with him; affection intimate, through peace and peril alike; traces of old things still remain before the eyes.
idiomatic: The late Emperor, holding the native place as the root, truly shared its fortune and misfortune; and I, though young and tender, unworthily shared his hardships. Our bond was intimate through peace and peril alike, and traces of the old days still live in memory.

literal: The years do not tarry; more than three decades have passed; the men of the time and the elders of old have fallen away with fate.
idiomatic: The years do not wait; more than three decades have passed, and the men of that time and the elders of old have vanished with the turning of fate.

literal: Looking back upon what is past, I am doubly moved to deep sighing.
idiomatic: Looking back on what is past, I am doubly moved to deep sighing.

literal: Search out civil and military gentlemen and commoners of that time who still survive today, and report all their names.
idiomatic: Search out the civil and military officers and commoners of that time who still survive, and report all their names.

literal: Where the person himself is dead but descendants still live, generously measure out rewards and gifts to them.
idiomatic: Where the person himself is dead but descendants remain, generously measure out rewards and gifts to them.

literal: " The imperial carriage set out by water from Dantu; on the renwu day, it reached the capital.
idiomatic: " The imperial carriage set out by water from Dantu; on the renwu day it reached the capital.

literal: On the bingxu day, the state of Bohuang; on the renchen day, the state of Boda—both sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Bohuang; on the renchen day, Boda—each sent envoys bearing local products as tribute.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinwei day, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was made Governor of Southern Xu Province; Prince of Guangling Dan was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on the xinwei day, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province, and Prince of Guangling Dan was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Prince of Pingcheng Hong, General of the Household Guards, was made Governor of Jiang Province.
idiomatic: On the jiyou day of the eighth month, Prince of Pingcheng Hong, General of the Household Guards, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

literal: On the guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was made Governor of Xiang Province.
idiomatic: On the guichou day, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Sui Commandery.

literal: On the jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was made General Who Campaigns North, with the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made Governor of Yang Province.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General of the Central Army and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed General Who Campaigns North, granted the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and made Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Southern Xu Province, became Governor of Yang Province.

literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on the xinwei day, provisional commandery and county appointments in Jiao and Ning provinces were regulated; salaries were to follow metropolitan appointments.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on the xinwei day, provisional commandery and county appointments in Jiao and Ning provinces were regulated, and salaries were ordered to follow metropolitan standards.

literal: On the xinmao day, the state of Paekche sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: On the xinmao day, Paekche sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: On the xinchou day of the second month, Prince of Nanping Shuo, General of the Right and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced in title to General Who Pacifies the West.
idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the second month, Prince of Nanping Shuo, General of the Right and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.

literal: On the xinhai day, [35] the Suo raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of the two commanderies of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of the two commanderies of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.
idiomatic: On the xinhai day, [35] the Suo raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.

literal: The Suo attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, acting in the affairs of Runan Commandery, resisted them.
idiomatic: The Suo attacked Xuancheng; Chen Xian, acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them.

literal: Because of the military emergency, the salaries of the hundred officials were reduced by one-third.
idiomatic: Because of the military emergency, the salaries of all officials were reduced by one-third.

literal: On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, requested that salaries be reduced in the same manner as the metropolitan officials; thereupon the assistants, clerks, and constables of provinces, commanderies, and counties were all likewise reduced.
idiomatic: On the yichou day of the third month, Zhuge Kan, Administrator of Huainan, asked that salaries be cut to match those of metropolitan officials; thereupon assistants, clerks, and constables throughout provinces, commanderies, and counties were all reduced alike.

literal: On the wuyin day, the Imperial University was abolished.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day, the Imperial University was abolished.

literal: On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was made General Who Protects the Army.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day, Xiao Sihua, newly appointed Minister of the Ministry of Personnel, was appointed General Who Protects the Army.

literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the renzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Pacifies the Army.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the renzi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General Who Pacifies the Army.

literal: On the dingyou day of the sixth month, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was made Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the sixth month, Xiao Bin, Palace Attendant, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

literal: On the gengwu day of the seventh month of autumn, Ningshuo General Wang Xuanmo was dispatched on a northern campaign.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the seventh month of autumn, Wang Xuanmo, General of Ningshuo, was dispatched on the northern campaign.

literal: Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong went out and encamped at Pengcheng, commanding all the armies.
idiomatic: Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong advanced and encamped at Pengcheng, taking overall command of the armies.

literal: On the yihai day, the Suo garrison at Qiepo abandoned the city and fled.
idiomatic: On the yihai day, the Suo garrison at Qiepo abandoned the city and withdrew.

literal: On the guihai day of the intercalary month of winter, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but did not take it; he was defeated by the barbarians and withdrew to Qiepo.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the intercalary month of winter, Xuanmo attacked Huatai but failed to take it; he was defeated by the enemy and withdrew to Qiepo.

literal: On the xinwei day, Prince of Sui Dan, Governor of Yong Province, dispatched troops to attack Hongnong city and captured it.
idiomatic: On the xinwei day, Prince of Sui Dan, Governor of Yong Province, sent troops to attack Hongnong and captured it.

literal: On the bingxu day, Guan city was again captured.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day, Guan city was captured as well.

literal: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suo captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of the two commanderies of Lu and Yangping, was captured.
idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the eleventh month, the Suo captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping, was taken captive.

literal: On the jiawu day, the army dispatched by Prince of Sui Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day, the army sent by Prince of Sui Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.

literal: On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left Army, was defeated in battle at Yuwu Garrison in Shouyang by the barbarians and was killed.
idiomatic: On the guimao day, Liu Kangzu, General of the Left Army, was defeated in battle by the enemy at Yuwu Garrison in Shouyang and was killed.

literal: On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
idiomatic: On the dingwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, strict guard was imposed within and without.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the twelfth month, strict guard was imposed within and without the palace.

literal: On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant of the Suite, Zang Cheng, General of Accumulated Crossbows for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were defeated in battle at Xuyi by the barbarians; all were killed.
idiomatic: On the yichou day, Hu Chongzhi, Supernumerary Attendant of the Suite, Zang Cheng, General of Accumulated Crossbows for the Heir Apparent, and Mao Xizuo, General Who Establishes Might, were defeated in battle at Xuyi by the enemy and were all killed.

literal: On the gengwu day, the barbarian pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.
idiomatic: On the gengwu day, the barbarian pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.

literal: On the renwu day, strict guard was imposed within and without.
idiomatic: On the renwu day, strict guard was again imposed within and without.

literal: On the first day of the first month of spring of the twenty-eighth year, the bingxu day of the new moon, because of the enemy's pressure there was no court assembly.
idiomatic: On the bingxu day, the new moon of the first month of spring of the twenty-eighth year, because of the enemy threat the court did not hold its new-year assembly.

literal: On the dinghai day, the Suo withdrew from Guabu.
idiomatic: On the dinghai day, the Suo withdrew from Guabu.

literal: On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi city.
idiomatic: On the dingyou day, they besieged Xuyi.

literal: That month, Ningshuo General Wang Xuanmo withdrew from Qiepo and returned to Lixia.
idiomatic: That month, Wang Xuanmo, General of Ningshuo, withdrew from Qiepo and returned to Lixia.

literal: On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suo fled in disorder from Xuyi.
idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the second month, the Suo broke camp and fled from Xuyi.

literal: On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun blaze fiercely, and hardship reaches several provinces; thinking of it with care, I wake and sleep in grief.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day, an edict said: "The Xianyun rage unchecked, and hardship reaches across several provinces; when I think of it, I cannot sleep for grief.

literal: The fierce Jie are wounded and broken, scattering in flight to distant places; the people they have maimed should now be restored in timely fashion.
idiomatic: The fierce foe is wounded and broken, fleeing far away; the people they have ravaged should now be restored without delay.

literal: In all commanderies and counties that suffered bandit raids, order the people to return and resume their occupations; bury exposed corpses and cover bare bones; relieve and support the hungry and displaced.
idiomatic: In every commandery and county ravaged by the enemy, order the people to return and resume their livelihoods; bury the dead left unburied and cover the bones left bare; relieve the hungry and shelter the displaced.

literal: Spring planting is just beginning; strive to the utmost in encouraging cultivation.
idiomatic: Spring planting is just beginning; exert every effort in encouraging the fields.

literal: As to the measures for lending and giving, let the matter follow generous treatment.
idiomatic: As to loans and relief, let every measure be generous.

literal: Those who have drifted to the Yangzi and Huai regions may all be registered where they now are, and remission and restoration of levies granted."
idiomatic: Those who have fled to the Yangzi and Huai regions may all be registered where they now dwell, and granted remission of taxes and corvée."

literal: On the jiaxu day, Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry, with the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
idiomatic: On the jiaxu day, Grand Marshal Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, concurrent Minister over the Masses, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with the privilege of Opening the Headquarters with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.

literal: On the xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the North Center.
idiomatic: On the xinsi day, Prince of Wuling Jun, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was reduced in rank to General of the North Center.

literal: On the renwu day, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; on that day strict guard was lifted.
idiomatic: On the renwu day, the Emperor visited Guabu; on that day the strict guard was lifted.

literal: On the yiyou day of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the third month, the Emperor returned to the palace.

literal: On the renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the renchen day, Prince of Shixing Jun, General Who Campaigns North, was relieved of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the gengzi day, Zang Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was made Governor of Yong Province.
idiomatic: On the gengzi day, Zang Zhi, General Who Assists the State, was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

literal: On the wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xu Province, was made Governor of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: On the wushen day, Prince of Wuling Jun, Governor of Xu Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was made General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
idiomatic: On the jiayin day, Xiao Sihua, General Who Protects the Army, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

literal: On the guiyou day of the fourth month of summer, the state of Boda sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: On the guiyou day of the fourth month of summer, Boda sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: The Suo pretender General Who Pacifies the South Lu Shuang and Secretariat Gentleman Lu Xiu submitted in allegiance.
idiomatic: The Suo pretender General Who Pacifies the South Lu Shuang and Secretariat Gentleman Lu Xiu came over in submission.

literal: On the wuyin day, Shuang was made Governor of Si Province.
idiomatic: On the wuyin day, Shuang was appointed Governor of Si Province.

literal: On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.
idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze styled himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou.

literal: On the dingsi day, the state of Bohuang; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—both sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: On the dingsi day, Bohuang; on the wuxu day, the King of Henan—each sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: [37] On the jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry, took up the post of Governor of Southern Yan Province.
idiomatic: [37] On the jisi day, Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, General of Agile Cavalry, assumed the governorship of Southern Yan Province.

literal: On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Vice Director of the Left of the Masters of Writing, was made Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Pazhi, Grandee Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was made Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.
idiomatic: On the wushen day, He Shangzhi, Vice Director of the Left of the Masters of Writing, was appointed Director of the Masters of Writing; Xu Pazhi, Grandee Mentor of the Heir Apparent, was appointed Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and General Who Protects the Army.

literal: On the renzi day, Prince of Sui Dan, General of the Rear, was made General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.
idiomatic: On the renzi day, Prince of Sui Dan, General of the Rear, was appointed General Who Pacifies the South and Governor of Guang Province.

literal: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, General of the North Center, was made Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Ardor and Administrator of Qin Commandery, was made Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
idiomatic: On the renxu day of the sixth month, Prince of Wuling Jun, General of the North Center, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province; Liu Xingzu, General Who Quells Martial Ardor and Administrator of Qin Commandery, was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

literal: On the jiachen day of the seventh month of autumn, the Wa king Wajin was advanced in title to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.
idiomatic: On the jiachen day of the seventh month of autumn, the Wa king Wajin was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the East.

literal: On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified; Sima Shunze was beheaded.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.

literal: On the guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Koguryo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: On the guihai day of the tenth month of winter, Koguryo sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.
idiomatic: On the renyin day of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji provinces.

literal: That winter, displaced people of Pengcheng were moved to Guabu, and displaced people west of the Huai to Gudu—together some ten thousand households.
idiomatic: That winter, displaced people from Pengcheng were resettled at Guabu, and those from west of the Huai at Gudu—together some ten thousand households.

literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on the jiawu day, an edict said: "The six provinces have suffered raids; livelihoods are not yet established; [38] they have again met with flood disaster, and hunger and distress come one upon another.
idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on the jiawu day, an edict said: "The six provinces have been ravaged by the enemy and livelihoods are not yet restored; [38] they have again suffered flooding, and hunger and distress follow in succession.

literal: Speedily dispatch orders to the various garrisons and generously measure out relief and support.
idiomatic: Orders should speedily go out to the various garrisons to grant generous relief.

literal: Now the agricultural work is rising; strive to the utmost in using the land's advantage.
idiomatic: Spring farming is now under way; exert every effort to make full use of the land.

literal: Where seed for the fields is needed, give it according to what is fitting."
idiomatic: Where seed is needed for the fields, supply it as circumstances require."

literal: On the gengshen day of the second month, the barbarian commander Tuoba Tao died.
idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the second month, the barbarian commander Tuoba Tao died.

literal: On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was established as Prince of Jian'an.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day, [39] the twelfth imperial son Xiuren was created Prince of Jian'an.

literal: On the wuwu day of the fourth month of summer, the state of Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute goods.
idiomatic: On the wuwu day of the fourth month of summer, Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute goods.

literal: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer to the General of Agile Cavalry, was made Governor of Ji Province.
idiomatic: Zhang Yong, Staff Officer to the General of Agile Cavalry, was appointed Governor of Ji Province.

literal: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.
idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.

literal: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on the bingshen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is full, the body perishes; the barbarian villain meets his constant fate; the cruel barbarian's utter depravity has been manifest since of old.
idiomatic: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were assigned to Guang Province; on the bingshen day, an edict said: "When wickedness is ripe, the man dies; the barbarian villain meets the fate that ever awaits him; the cruel enemy's utter depravity has been manifest since antiquity.
